Nsowah). This file maps every item to where the work actually lands. Copy in the
PDF's shaded boxes is **final** - paste verbatim, do not rewrite.

**Source of truth is `wordpress/`.** Root `*.html` and `assets/` are generated by
`python tools/build-static.py`. Never hand-edit the root copies.

## Blocker before anything else

The PDF opens by fixing the contact address:

> The correct address is **`connect@theaccessexchange.com`**. This is the only
> email address that should appear anywhere on the site or receive any form
> submission. Verify the mailbox exists and that a test submission arrives
> before the job is marked complete.

That is the **custom domain**, not the `.onmicrosoft.com` tenant address we were
handed. So:

- Adding `theaccessexchange.com` to the Microsoft 365 tenant is now **required**,
  not the optional §1.6 upgrade in `CF7-SMTP.md`.
- Everything currently pointing at `connect@theaccessexchange.onmicrosoft.com`
  has to move to `connect@theaccessexchange.com` once the mailbox exists.
- `hello@theaccessexchange.com` is dead - it was our placeholder and the client
  has now named its replacement. Remove every occurrence.
- The MFA blocker still stands: the OAuth authorisation needs Akosua present.

**Nothing in Section 7.3 can be signed off until that mailbox exists.**

## Three buckets

Not all of this is code. Separating it prevents chasing DB content in the repo.

| Bucket | What it covers | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **A. Repo** | Copy, markup, nav, forms, page structure | `wordpress/*.html`, plugin templates |
| **B. wp-admin** | Deleting seeded interviews, Yoast fields, GA4, CF7 mail tabs, page draft states | Live WordPress |
| **C. Blocked** | Needs the client, or needs the mailbox | - |

The placeholder interviews ("Blender Video as placeholder", `test-image` alt,
David/Daniel Okafor, Maria/Marie Chen, "Episode 12") are **bucket B**. They are
seeded CPT rows in the live database, not markup in this repo - the importer and
seed data were already removed from the plugin. Do not go looking for them here.

## Open questions for the client

1. **`get-involved.html`** - not in the new nav and never mentioned in the PDF.
   Retire it, or keep it footer-linked like coaching? It currently hosts the
   general inquiry form (4.13) and a visible `hello@` address.
2. **Team members beyond the founder.** 6.1 says label everyone else "Team
   Member" and reuse the guest-card descriptors - which covers Shukur and
   Angelica. The About page currently shows four more placeholder people. Are
   Shukur and Angelica the whole team, and the rest deleted?
3. **Mailing list provider** for 2.6. **DECIDED 2026-09-03: double opt-in
   confirmed, provider still to be chosen and wired later.** CF7 cannot do
   double opt-in, so this becomes a Mailchimp / Brevo / ConvertKit embed (all
   free at this volume). Until then `REPLACE_ID_JOIN` is a placeholder in two
   places - `wordpress/index.html` and `wordpress/footer.html` - and the
   Subscribe button is inert. Keep `html_class="form form--join"` on whatever
   replaces it, or the `join_the_exchange` conversion stops firing.
4. **LinkedIn company page** - include the footer line or omit it?
5. **Written guest approvals.** 3.2 says publish a card only after Akosua
   confirms in writing that the guest approved name, title and employer. Five
   cards, five confirmations needed before that block goes live.
